# Streamloots script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## streamloots.isConnected

Checks whether Cuebot is connected to your StreamLoots alerts right now.

**Gives back:** true while connected, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamloots.isConnected");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.streamloots_is_connected()
    ```

## streamloots.sendTestEvent

Fakes a StreamLoots alert inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to StreamLoots and it works without a connection.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `kind` | Optional. Which alert: "purchase", "gift", "communityGift" or "redemption" (a card was used). Default "redemption". |

**Gives back:** true when the test alert was sent, false when the kind is unknown.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamloots.sendTestEvent", new { kind = "purchase" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.streamloots_send_test_event(kind="purchase")
    ```
